source: A scripted elkbench run (T208) on Iced-Cream's Analog Rytm MKII, approved by Iced-Cream, with Iced-Cream's power cycle by hand; plans, screens and readbacks kept in the author's private test log.
statement: Hardware, OS 1.74, build CPH2 (2026-11-08): with MODE CV in GLOBAL > CONTROL > CONTROL INPUT 1, PERF DEST is the last row, steps OFF, PF1..PF12 and holds at both ends, and MODE OFF hides it. PF1 was kept over a project save and reload and over a power cycle by hand, and set back to OFF after. With nothing plugged into EXP/CV IN 1 the port reads below CV ZERO and macro 1 stays at 0. analoghealth read the CPU at 74.6% and 74.8% 30 s apart, with the heap flat. Stock 1.74 was flashed back after the run.
scope: ctrl-in-perf 1.0.0-experimental alone on the Modwerk base for core-ar2 0.7, with analoghealth 1.3 for remote keys. Not run on the unit: a CV source driving a macro (emulator only), EXPR mode, CONTROL INPUT 2, a listening check.

builds.label: CPH2
builds.content: CP02 (the Modwerk base for core-ar2 0.7, plain variant, and this module alone, f154018e…08b9) plus the analoghealth 1.3 remote-key layer. Driven over USB by a scripted bench in a ~T test project; stock 1.74 restored after the run.
results: PERF DEST is the last row in CV mode, steps OFF..PF12 and holds at both ends; MODE OFF hides it (screens).
PF1 kept over a project save and reload, and over a power cycle by hand (screens).
CPU 74.6% and 74.8% 30 s apart, heap flat (analoghealth).
